reviews.summary: reviewer argued that exposing priority, sizing, etc. adds unnecessary work to userspace and should be avoided unless justified
sentiment_signals: requested justification for adding work to userspace
reviews.raw_body:
Just for completeness, here is later during the second stage of the GCC

2026-09-23.patch_summary: This patch aims to simplify virtualized swap by making its default behavior as transparent and hassle-free for userspace as possible. It does this by removing the need for userspace to handle priority, sizing, and other complexities, instead focusing on a straightforward approach.
